about: Running shorts (running-shorts-textured.glb, RUGBYV 2026-11-23): coloured from the same garment split into parts by Tripo (running-shorts-parts.glb) by viewer/tripo-glbparts.mjs: the gathered waistband (tripo_part_56) the Waistband part, one smooth line at its foot; the hem bindings (tripo_part_11) the Hem part (listed as `sleeves`: one piece with one smooth border; pastBody 1 turns the sleeves' 'past the body's side' rule off). The side panels (tripo_part_44) are NOT coloured (coordinator 23 Nov: their parts-file edges are ragged; the card's yellow panels are a fixer item in pending_on_models.md): body, side panels and small bits the print. Inside: the cloth's own colour in shade.
